Case study

Make network behavior visible enough to reason about.

SimulationNetworksVisualizationPython

The goal

Queueing, route choice, and congestion are easier to understand when the network can be observed while it runs. This project turns those interactions into a visual simulator with a dashboard and statistics output.

The build

Developed with Kanak Varma, the repository combines simulation logic, an interface, a recorded demonstration, and a statistics report. It was structured as an inspectable experiment rather than a single fixed animation.

Illustrative traffic load over timesimulation steps

Takeaway

A simulator is most useful when it connects a visual event to a measurable quantity. The project strengthened my interest in tools that let people explore system behavior, not just see a final number.
